title: When AI Builds Faster Than Engineers Can Understand
description: A 196,212-PR study found AI doubled output per engineer while human review coverage fell from 89% to 68%. What the comprehension gap is, and how to measure it.
og_alt: AI Outpaces Engineering Comprehension. Implementation, verification and comprehension as three separate questions.
